newsitem.title: USA: No date yet for new Turkey-IMF talks-IMF source.
newsitem.headline: No date yet for new Turkey-IMF talks-IMF source.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund has exchanged letters with Turkey's new finance minister, but no date has yet been set for talks on a new loan program, an IMF source said on Tuesday.
Turkey's Milliyet newspaper on Tuesday quoted economy minister Gunes Taner as saying that the IMF was ready to help Turkey's new government draw up an economic program.
"The IMF is ready to assist the economic program of the Turkish authorities. We will open discussions on the program to be prepared," the newspaper quoted an IMF letter as saying.

The IMF, which wants Turkey to do more to rein in inflation and create the conditions for sustainable growth, said earlier this month that the authorities needed to act on structural reform and to reform the banking system.
The Turkish government, describing the IMF report as an assessment of "a previous era in the economy" says it is already taking measures to stabilize the economy and bring inflation down.
